tasks.subject: Task 1: Synthesize the <fk>Version history field
tasks.description:
**Goal:** EntityDef.historyEntityDef gains a synthetic <fk>Version: Long field for every FK field whose target entity has recordVersionHistory = true, including FK fields declared directly on a concrete subclass.

**Files:**
- Modify: maia-gen/maia-gen-spec/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/spec/definition/EntityDef.kt:469-542, :1035-1124
- Test: maia-gen/maia-gen-spec/src/test/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/spec/HistoryFkValidationTest.kt

**Verify:** ./gradlew :maia-gen:maia-gen-spec:test --tests "org.maiaframework.gen.spec.HistoryFkValidationTest"

See plan file Task 1 for full step-by-step code. NOTE: original guardrail approach (rejecting subclassed hierarchies via ModelDefinitionException in AbstractSpec.kt) was reverted after discovering the real maia-showcase spec already has this case (OrgUserGroup.org -> Organization) -- see plan header's "Scope correction" note. Task 2 now supports hierarchies instead.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["maia-gen/maia-gen-spec/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/spec/definition/EntityDef.kt", "maia-gen/maia-gen-spec/src/test/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/spec/HistoryFkValidationTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew :maia-gen:maia-gen-spec:test --tests \"org.maiaframework.gen.spec.HistoryFkValidationTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["synthesized <fk>Version field appears with correct name/type/nullability when FK target is historized", "field absent when FK target is not historized", "FK field declared on a concrete subclass gets the same treatment on its own historyEntityDef, no hierarchy-specific code needed"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wire the live version lookup into the generated DAO
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The generated <Entity>Dao for a history-tracked entity with FK field(s) to other history-tracked entities gets the referenced entity's Dao injected, a findVersionByPrimaryKey lookup added to that referenced Dao, and the lookup wired into history()/insertHistory()/bulkInsertHistory() -- covering BOTH the non-hierarchy and hasSubclasses() code paths, since the real maia-showcase spec already has a historized FK declared on a concrete subclass (OrgUserGroup.org).

**Files:**
- Modify: maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/renderers/JdbcDaoRenderer.kt

**Verify:** ./gradlew :maia-gen:maia-gen-generator:build

See plan file Task 2 for full step-by-step code (helper functions, DI injection, findVersionByPrimaryKey render fn, insertHistory rewrite (both branches), bulkInsertHistory rewrite (both branches), history() signature rewrite (both branches), build).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/renderers/JdbcDaoRenderer.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew :maia-gen:maia-gen-generator:build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["findVersionByPrimaryKey generated on historized entities", "referenced Dao injected and deduped across whole hierarchy", "history() gains extra params in both hasSubclasses() and non-hierarchy branches", "insertHistory/bulkInsertHistory look up and pass through version in both branches"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Model the composite FK in the expected-schema extractor

- Test: maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/test/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/schema/ExpectedSchemaExtractorTest.kt

**Verify:** ./gradlew :maia-gen:maia-gen-generator:test --tests "org.maiaframework.gen.schema.ExpectedSchemaExtractorTest"

See plan file Task 3 for full step-by-step code (new ExpectedCompositeForeignKeyDef data class, extractTable() rewrite, test). No hierarchy-specific work needed here -- already driven by entityHierarchy.allFieldDefsSorted which spans the whole hierarchy generically.


tasks.subject: Task 5: Teach the schema-check tool about composite FKs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** SchemaComparator doesn't false-flag a real composite FK constraint's columns as missing/extra, and SchemaFixSqlGenerator can generate correct composite ALTER TABLE fix-SQL.

**Files:**

- Modify: maia-gen/maia-gen-schema-check/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/schemacheck/SchemaFixSqlGenerator.kt
- Test: maia-gen/maia-gen-schema-check/src/test/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/schemacheck/SchemaComparatorTest.kt
- Test: maia-gen/maia-gen-schema-check/src/test/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/schemacheck/SchemaFixSqlGeneratorTest.kt

No changes needed to PostgresSchemaIntrospector/ActualSchemaModel -- the introspection query already flattens multi-column FK constraints correctly.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :maia-gen:maia-gen-schema-check:test --tests "org.maiaframework.gen.schemacheck.SchemaComparatorTest" --tests "org.maiaframework.gen.schemacheck.SchemaFixSqlGeneratorTest"
